body:
Source: GitHub issue #688 (bug, P1-high, area:review). Re-verified on main @ e4a62e78: packages/model-ratchet/bin/model-ratchet.mjs:158. In review mode (`reviewCmd && !values['dry-run']`), when zero files are selected (e.g. repo contains no supported source files, or churn/walk is empty), `for (const row of selected)` never executes and the CLI prints `Total findings: 0` and exits 0. A scheduled CI job passes green forever while auditing nothing.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/model-ratchet`: `bin/model-ratchet.mjs` (CLI entry point), `lib/walk.mjs` (walkSourceFiles, SOURCE_EXTS), `lib/scoring.mjs`, `lib/review.mjs`, `lib/graph.mjs`. Tests: `npm test -w packages/model-ratchet` from the worktree root.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In `bin/model-ratchet.mjs`: When in review mode (`reviewCmd && !values['dry-run']`), if `selected.length === 0` and `!values['allow-empty']`: print a warning to stderr stating no source files were selected for review, and exit with code 2 (gate failure). In `--json` output, surface `selectedCount: 0`.
2. Add CLI flag `--allow-empty` for the explicit opt-in case where an empty selection is allowed to exit 0.
3. In `lib/walk.mjs`: Widen `SOURCE_EXTS` to include `.cjs`, `.mts`, `.cts`, `.jsx` in addition to `.mjs`, `.js`, `.ts`, `.tsx`, `.py`.
4. Documentation: update `packages/model-ratchet/README.md`, `docs/tools/model-ratchet.md`, and `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/model-ratchet.mdx` (hand-maintained mirrors — never regenerate).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 Review mode with 0 selected files exits 2 and prints warning naming no source files selected. verify: `node --test packages/model-ratchet/test/empty-selection.test.mjs`
- AC2 Review mode with --allow-empty exits 0 when 0 files selected. verify: `node --test packages/model-ratchet/test/empty-selection.test.mjs`
- AC3 SOURCE_EXTS recognizes .cjs, .mts, .cts, .jsx files. verify: `node --test packages/model-ratchet/test/empty-selection.test.mjs`
- AC4 Existing test suite passes with no regressions. verify: `npm test -w packages/model-ratchet`
- AC5 Docs updated in all three mirror files. verify: `grep -c "allow-empty" packages/model-ratchet/README.md docs/tools/model-ratchet.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/model-ratchet.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC6 Mutation gate green on branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12`

OUT OF SCOPE: Issue #689 (subdirectory run key-space mismatch) or #690 (Windows separator).
title: model-ratchet: warn and fail non-zero in review mode when zero candidate files are selected
